name: Healthcare Clinical & Pharmaceutical R&D Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Healthcare Clinical Operations and Pharmaceutical R&D, covering patient intake, EHR clinical notes, e-prescriptions, lab/imaging LIS/PACS workflows, clinical trial management (CTMS), adverse event reporting (pharmacovigilance), and pharma batch release.

checklists.name: Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Clinical Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for EHR documentation, CPOE order entry, clinical trial eCRFs, and SAE pharmacovigilance.

items.statement: Clinical EHR notes follow SOAP structure and incorporate ICD-10 / SNOMED CT diagnostic codes.
Computerized Provider Order Entry (CPOE) checks for drug-drug interactions and patient allergy alerts.
Clinical trial subjects execute Informed Consent Forms (ICF) prior to protocol enrollment.
Serious Adverse Events (SAE) are reported to the Medical Monitor and Institutional Review Board (IRB) within 24 hours.
Pharmaceutical manufacturing batch records undergo Qualified Person (QP) release sign-off prior to distribution.

reviewGates.name: Chief Medical Officer Clinical Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Chief Medical Officer and Head of Pharmacovigilance confirm that EHR clinical safety and trial SAE workflows comply with GCP guidelines.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the healthcare documentation confirm clinical safety and pharmacovigilance compliance?
